We also host workshops for anyone who wants to learn, contact us if you're interested!

description: WUSM for Life fosters dialogue about navigating medical education and practice as pro-life physicians. We host speakers and public forums to discuss approaches to medical decisions from a pro-life perspective.

name: WUSM Ski & Board
description: The mission of WUSM Ski & Board is to provide students with an opportunity to combine their love of skiing with their passion for medicine in a way that both gives back to the community and increases their knowledge and skills. Our members will partner with the Gateway Disabled Ski Program at Hidden Valley Resort, an organization that provides free adaptive skiing lessons for individuals with disabilities in the STL community. Additionally, members will have the opportunity to obtain their Outdoor Emergency Care certificate and participate as volunteer Ski Patrollers at the resort.

description: The WUSM Wine Society seeks to foster an appreciation for and knowledge of the art of wine-making and wine-tasting. Through various educational lessons, the Wine Society aims to bring students together to learn about various types of wine, how to taste and identify tasting notes, and develop their wine palates.

name: WUSM-GO
description: Wash U School of Medicine Gaming Club! Organized by medical students to provide opportunities to play video games and board games with each other and faculty.

description: The Yoga & Meditation Club provides a welcoming space for medical and graduate students to practice yoga, meditation, mindfulness, and other movement-based wellness activities. Through regular sessions and collaborative programming, the club aims to support physical and mental well-being while building community and connections among students across disciplines.
